capabilities: Render the vault as a 3D force-directed graph with fly, orbit, and search controls
Show a stats panel counting files, wikilinks, unresolved links, and words
Export the link structure as a DNA CSV snapshot
Export graph nodes and edges as CSV for Noda VR on Quest 3
Color nodes by top-level folder to act as a filter legend
disambiguation: Despite the AI 'Digent brain' framing, it is not an AI agent tool; it visualizes and exports the vault link graph.
extras: Conceptual framing draws on an external 'Digent White Paper V1.0'; installation is manual via release downloads. Includes .canvas boards in the graph alongside .md files, and states there are no network requests or telemetry.
intentEvidence: Built on top of Galaxy View. Thanks to @longwind1984 for the original work.
problem: Obsidian's 2D graph view flattens dense connection structure onto a single plane, hiding how notes cluster and relate in space.

relations.evidence: Built on top of Galaxy View. Thanks to @longwind1984 for the original work.
One click exports the 3D graph as CSV, ready to import into Noda (Quest 3 VR).

summary: 3D force-directed graph view that renders the vault's Markdown link structure as a 'Digent' brain, with vault stats and CSV exports.
